audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Levels 3, 4-5, First item and 2+ items to Wukong, while content 'late' opens 'You own this lane the whole way because he builds armor and you ignore it' and whys[2], [3] and [5] all describe Neeko punishing.
audit.why: Packet chart is [Skill, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Skill]; win rate 70% over 10 games. The armour-vs-magic-damage argument the page itself makes is the reason those middle rows belong to Neeko; the genuine hand-off is 2+ items, which the packet marks Skill rather than Wukong.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 to Neeko and row 6 to Skill, as one atomic pair-matched group.

audit.why: Four spikes present and sensibly staged: Lvl 1 his, Lvl 3 Q+E, Lvl 6 Pop Blossom, 2+ items his. Neeko's own numbers back the Lvl 3 window — E at 12s and Q at 9s rank 1 means a root-plus-rebloom every rotation.

audit.whatIsWrong: Only Nimbus Strike is ever named. Crushing Blow, Warrior Trickster and Cyclone are all referred to by nickname — 'Q armor-shred', 'W decoy clone', 'R spin' — which is exactly the defect the packet flags.
audit.why: The packet's ability list gives the real names: Stone Skin (P), Crushing Blow (Q), Warrior Trickster (W), Nimbus Strike (E), Cyclone (R). The mechanics described are right; only the names were missing, so this is a naming fix, not a mechanics rewrite.
audit.corrected: Named Crushing Blow, Warrior Trickster and Cyclone in the lines where each actually drives the decision.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers for Nimbus Strike, which the page calls the matchup-defining ability and the whole green-light system.
audit.why: enemyKit is null in this brief — Wukong's cooldowns are not available to me from the kits, and I will not write a number I cannot source. Neeko-side numbers I do have (E 12s, R 120/105/90) are already reflected.

edits.before: Level 1 he out-stats you — his Q armor-shred and E dash poke while you only have single-target Blooming Burst and no combo.
edits.after: Level 1 he out-stats you — Crushing Blow (Q) and Nimbus Strike (E) poke while you have only single-target Blooming Burst.

edits.before: Bait your E (Tangle-Barbs) onto his W decoy clone, then E-dash in on you while your root is on cooldown
edits.after: Bait Tangle-Barbs (E) onto his Warrior Trickster (W) decoy, then Nimbus Strike in while your root is down

edits.before: Land his R spin knockup to interrupt your Pop Blossom wind-up and burst you before your shields come back
edits.after: Land Cyclone (R) to knock you out of the Pop Blossom wind-up and burst you before your shields come back

notes: enemyKit is null in this brief, so I had no Riot text or cooldowns for Wukong — every claim about his mechanics was left as written and only the ability NAMES were corrected, using the packet's own ability list. That closes the flagged defect without inventing anything. Two claims I could not verify and therefore did not touch: (a) that Cyclone's knockup interrupts Neeko's Pop Blossom wind-up — plausible, but Neeko's R carries no channel flag and Riot only says 'after a short preparation'; (b) that Neeko's W grants invisibility, repeated in spikes[2], mid and wants.you[1] — Riot's W text describes a clone plus bonus damage and move speed with no stealth flag. Both recur across this champion. Difficulty is still TRICKY 7/10 while the chart now reads Neeko for five of seven rows; the packet supports the chart, so the enum may want revisiting once Wukong's kit is available.
